correctness.rationale: The product formula follows from the full text of [1]. For arbitrary interior x,y the exact nonnegative polynomial identity R_h(y)^2-(1-t)^2R_h(0)^2=b^4Ht[2H+6-(H+2)t] and the stronger R_h(y)^2>=R_h(0)^2 for h>=b show strict reduction to y=0. Differentiation of the exact rational objective in s=x^2 yields derivative sign ((s-A)^2-B(4A+B)); this has exactly the claimed critical regime, with both extremizer coordinates verified admissible by explicit first-three pedal-vertex geometry. The standard-library checker independently reconstructs four steps and tests algebraic identities. Finite tests do not prove universality.
